description: List the organizations this sign-in can reach. Use it first when no organization is known, when several may apply, or when asked what you can access. Returns orgs[] with slug (pass it as org to other tools), name, role, and a dashboard url.
name: list_my_orgs

keyBound.description: Present and true when an API key is bound to exactly this one organization.

slug.description: Organization slug; pass it as `org` to other tools.
